d:
"A detective noir comic with murder, drugs and cute animals. Updates several times every month!"

Here's Dust to Dust. A Detective/Noir webcomic following a rabbit cop name Abbi and her gray alien partner name MM through their an investigation of a murder case involving some new prescription drug, Evol; a drug designed to accelerate evolution.

It was first started on October 24th, 2016 and was last updated on March 26, 2021 for..... some reason. Yeah, the artist never gave a reason why they stop doing this comic, so it's pretty unknown what happen.

Shame really. I was really liking where the comic was going, but it is what it is.
I'm posted all the comic pages the artist did of this plus some miscellaneous pics that relate to this comic or the characters. I will mostly likely come back to this to add in more to this set when I find more.
